title: Hasbro Unveils Legend of Zelda Heroes of Hyrule Figures at Comic-Con 2026
excerpt: Three action figures — Link, Zelda, and Ganondorf — based on Tears of the Kingdom hit shelves Spring 2027, with pre-orders opening today on Hasbro Pulse.
body:
• Hasbro has unveiled its first Legend of Zelda action figures, featuring Link, Zelda, and Ganondorf from Tears of the Kingdom at Comic-Con 2026.
  • The figures include over 20 points of articulation and come with character-specific accessories.
  • Link and Zelda are priced at $27.99 each, while Ganondorf is priced at $42.99, with availability set for Spring 2027.
  • Pre-orders will begin on July 22, 2026, through Hasbro Pulse and major retailers.
Key Takeaways
  • Hasbro launches Heroes of Hyrule figures: Link, Zelda, and Ganondorf from Tears of the Kingdom.
  • Figures feature 20+ points of articulation and character-specific accessories.
  • Link and Zelda priced at $27.99; Ganondorf at $42.99, available Spring 2027.
  • Future waves of figures are planned, including characters from Ocarina of Time.
  • Pre-orders start July 22, 2026, on Hasbro Pulse and major retailers.

Hasbro and Nintendo Make It Official

Hasbro has officially pulled back the curtain on its first Legend of Zelda action figures, timed to San Diego Comic-Con 2026. The three-figure debut, branded Heroes of Hyrule, includes Link, Princess Zelda, and Ganondorf — all rendered in their Tears of the Kingdom designs, according to IGN, which first published images of the figures on July 22.

https://x.com/flickeringmyth/status/2080047314056466866

The reveal caps a week of teasing from Hasbro, which last week announced a multi-year licensing partnership with Nintendo for Zelda merchandise and followed up with an image of the Master Sword and Hylian Shield posted to its X account alongside the message: "The hero's journey begins tomorrow."

"For decades, The Legend of Zelda franchise has captivated fans through its deep lore, unforgettable characters and enduring sense of discovery. By combining Nintendo's iconic storytelling with Hasbro's leadership in action and role-play, we're delivering toys that invite fans to play, explore and forge their own epic adventures."

— Billy Lagor, President of Toys and Board Games, Hasbro

What the Figures Look Like

All three figures sit in a 6-inch scale, though Ganondorf towers over his companions at 7.5 inches tall. Each has 20-plus points of articulation and ships with accessories tailored to the character:

  • Link — Hylian Shield, Master Sword, interchangeable Zonai power hand, and a soft cloth cape.
  • Princess Zelda — Decayed Master Sword and an interchangeable right hand.
  • Ganondorf — Gloom Sword, scabbard, and an interchangeable right hand.

The figures are packaged in window-box packaging featuring game-inspired character art, according to product descriptions shared by Hasbro. Link and Zelda are priced at $27.99 each, with Ganondorf commanding a premium at $42.99, as reported by GameRant and Nintendo Everything.

Tears of the Kingdom, Not the Movie

Several outlets noted that the figures draw from the 2023 game Tears of the Kingdom rather than the upcoming live-action Legend of Zelda film, which is currently scheduled for release around May 2027. Nintendo Everything reported that this surprised some fans who had speculated the Hasbro partnership would be tied to the movie's marketing push.

The decision to lead with the game designs may signal that movie-tied merchandise will arrive separately, closer to the film's premiere. CBR noted that Nintendo of America's official Instagram account shared images of the Heroes of Hyrule line, with a tentative retail launch date of May 1, 2027 — just days after the movie opens.

A Big Year for Zelda Fans

The Heroes of Hyrule figures arrive during a packed stretch for the franchise. Zelda celebrated its 40th anniversary in February 2026, and Nintendo confirmed during its June Direct that a full remake of Ocarina of Time is coming to the Nintendo Switch 2 later this year. The live-action Zelda film, directed by Wes Ball, is tracking for an April-May 2027 release window.

Hasbro and Nintendo have confirmed these three figures are just the beginning. The multi-year agreement leaves room for future waves spanning the franchise's deep roster — characters like Sidon, Riju, and entries from Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask are considered likely candidates, according to CBR.

Pre-Orders and Availability

Pre-orders open on Hasbro Pulse at 5 PM PT / 8 PM ET on July 22, 2026. The figures will also be available through major retailers including Amazon and Walmart. Nintendo Life noted that availability details for buyers outside the United States have yet to be announced, a point worth watching for collectors in the Indian diaspora and other international markets.
